What PixelVows does

Practical web development for real businesses

I build websites that are clear, fast and easy to use on a phone. Each project starts with understanding what your business needs and who your visitors are, then moves through planning, design, development and testing.

My technical background is a BE in Computer Science, with hands-on work in WordPress and React, and an interest in the digital marketing side of online businesses.

No client portfolio is claimed on this page. Confirmed work is shown on the Work page, and demos or concepts are clearly labelled.

Services

What I can build for you

Business website development

A clear, professional site that explains what you do, builds trust and makes it easy to enquire.

Landing page development

A focused page for one product, service or campaign, with a single clear action.

WordPress website development

WordPress sites you can edit yourself, set up with a tidy structure and sensible plugins.

React frontend development

Custom, fast frontends for sites and interfaces that need more flexibility than a template.

Portfolio websites

School and educational institution websites

Information-rich sites for schools and institutions: admissions, programmes, notices and contact.

Website redesign

Refresh an outdated website with better structure, clarity and mobile experience.

Responsive website development

Layouts that work properly on phones, tablets and desktops.

Maintenance and improvement

Ongoing updates, fixes and improvements as agreed with you.

Basic on-page SEO setup

Page titles, descriptions, headings and structure so search engines can understand your site.

Content and structure planning

A sitemap and content plan before design starts, so the site is built around real needs.

Development workflow

From first call to launch

A simple seven-step process.

  1. 1

    Understand your requirements

    We talk through your business, audience and goals.

  2. 2

    Plan the sitemap and content

    Decide the pages, what each one says and what visitors should do.

  3. 3

    Design the interface

    Layout, colours and typography that suit your brand.

  4. 4

    Develop the website

    Build the pages with clean, maintainable code.

  5. 5

    Test responsiveness and functionality

    Check phones, tablets and desktops, plus forms and links.

  6. 6

    Deploy once hosting and domain are confirmed

    Go live after the hosting and domain details are sorted out.

  7. 7

    Maintenance or handover

    Ongoing support or a clean handover, as agreed.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you publish prices?

No fixed prices are listed because every project differs in pages, features and content. Share your requirements and you’ll get a quote or a way forward. The budget field in the form is only an indication so the project can be scoped.

WordPress or React: which should I choose?

WordPress suits sites you want to edit yourself, like business sites, blogs and catalogues. A custom React build suits more specific interfaces and performance needs. If you’re unsure, describe your goals and we’ll recommend one.

Do you handle hosting and domain?

Deployment happens after the required hosting and domain details are confirmed. We’ll explain the options and what you need to arrange.

Will my site work on mobile?

Yes. Responsive design and mobile testing are part of the workflow.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. Website redesign is one of the services. Share the current site and what you’d like to improve.

Can I see your previous work?

Confirmed projects appear on the Work page with clear labels. Anything that is a demo or concept is marked as such, and no client work is listed that hasn’t been confirmed.

Do you offer maintenance after launch?

Yes, as agreed with you: ongoing updates and improvements, or a clean handover so you can manage it yourself.
